reliability.crash.toastTitle: Agent Pets hit an internal error
reliability.crash.toastBody: The error was contained and the app keeps running. If your pet stops responding, reload it from the menu.
reliability.startup.failedMessage: Some services could not start. You can restart Agent Pets or quit for now.
reliability.renderer.gaveUpTitle: The pet view could not recover
reliability.renderer.gaveUpBody: Automatic reloads kept failing. Choose "Reload pet" from the menu or restart Agent Pets.
reliability.server.portBusyBody: Local port {port} is held by another program, so agent events cannot arrive. Close the old Agent Pets or the program using it.
reliability.server.failedBody: Local port {port} could not start, so agent events cannot arrive. Check system permissions or firewall settings.
reliability.server.bannerBusy: Port {port} is in use. Retrying automatically (attempt {attempt}).
reliability.server.bannerBusyAgentPets: Port {port} is held by another Agent Pets. Close it first.
